plan-core.basis: plan identity is written at creation and does not change during execution
plan-design seals context before phase execution

phase-index.basis: plan-design seals phase context before execution

item-spec.basis: the complete item specification is sealed before execution

predicates.path_volatility: for every paths.<reader>.slots sequence, registry volatility rank is monotonically nondecreasing
predicates.section_volatility: for every section_order sequence, volatility rank is monotonically nondecreasing
predicates.executor_history_exclusion: no executor slot resolves a registry carrier whose class is history
predicates.executor_handoff_exclusion: no executor slot carrier id is handoff
predicates.carrier_resolution: every slot has exactly one carrier_id and one deterministic resolver
predicates.bundle_input_resolution: every bundle input is a digest-qualified whole file or an explicitly declared section/symbol slice; inferred selectors and unmeasured mandatory bytes are forbidden
